summary: The stakeholder emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate Program for their district and opposes any termination or weakening of the program.

claims.argument: Without E-RATE, the district would struggle to afford new networking equipment and ISP services
claims.evidence_quote: Because of E-Rate the district has been able to build a sophisticated, robust, and fast wired/wireless network that connects our students to the online and digital resources they require for their learning.
